items.title: Duffy Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 17, 1995

ctx.x: He included them in what he was doing.

Well he was an educator until the day he left us. And I just gave Nat Adderley a big hug before, like 25 minutes ago, saying, “Man I love you so much.” You know people that know him intimately call him Naddely, but that’s another story. But you know the wild part about it there is a certain feeling about making music with either your brother — like Nat and Cannonball; or your father — Chubby and Duffy; or the Wynton Marsalis family, with all those great Marsalises. You know there’s something about making music…
It’s all downhill from here, so—
